Horned_Frontal_Skull.description: A heavy, reinforced cranium sporting massive permanent keratin horns growing over a vascularized bone core. The skull's internal architecture is highly honeycombed to absorb the horrific shock of full-speed cranial impacts against rivals.

Elongated_Herbivore_Cranium.description: An incredibly elongated facial profile designed to extend the teeth as far forward as possible. This places the mouth deeply into tall grass for grazing securely while keeping the high-mounted eyes stationed like watchtowers.
